title: Efficacy of the Combination of Simvastatin Plus Rifaximin in Patients With Decompensated Cirrhosis to Prevent ACLF Development

sections.abstract: The aim of this study is to assess the efficacy of oral administration of simvastatin plus rifaximin in patients with decompensated cirrhosis to halt the progression of the disease as assessed by prevention of the development of ACLF
